PROSPECTUS SUMMARY

The clinical collaboration will be reviewed after 180 days. This statement does not restrict sales
of securities and is included here only as a description of the research program.

UNDERWRITING

Our directors, executive officers and substantially all holders of our common stock have agreed
with the underwriters that they will not offer, sell, contract to sell or otherwise dispose of any
shares of common stock for 180 days after the date of this prospectus. An aggregate of 12,500,000
shares are subject to the lock-up agreement. The representatives may waive these restrictions and
release all or a portion of the shares before the end of the period.

The company has agreed not to issue or sell common stock for 90 days after the date of this
prospectus, subject to customary employee-plan exceptions.

SHARES ELIGIBLE FOR FUTURE SALE

Under separate agreements, certain selling stockholders may not sell their shares until the
restrictions terminate on January 15, 2027. If release would occur during a blackout period, the
release may be adjusted until after the blackout period; no particular adjusted date is stated.

DESCRIPTION OF CAPITAL STOCK

We are authorized to issue 200,000,000 shares. This authorization is not a lock-up agreement.
